title: Zip Lines, High Ropes and Adventure Parks for Families
description: Family adventure days out: zip lines, treetop high ropes, indoor skydiving and big adventure parks in the UK, with age, height and weight rules to check first.
h1: Zip lines, high ropes and big adventures
intro: Rope bridges in the treetops, zip wires over valleys and floating on air in a wind tunnel. These are the days out older kids and teens talk about for weeks.

image.alt: Riding a zip line through a forest

blocks.title: Scout’s adventure verdict
blocks.text: Check the age, height and weight rules for each course before booking. They decide which course your family can do together.

sections.html:
• Courses often have minimum ages and heights, and some rides have weight limits.
  • Under-16s may need a participating adult with them.
  • Outdoor courses can close in high winds or storms.

Read zip lines and high ropes in the UK and indoor skydiving for kids.

faqs.q: What age can kids go on zip lines?
faqs.a: It depends on the course. Junior courses can suit younger children, while big zip lines often have higher minimum ages and weight limits. Check the provider’s rules.
